{{Quote|I'm just a simple dealer in wanted goods.|Spa Fon to Jax Pavan|<ref name="sos" />}}
'''Spa Fon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lonjair]] who dealt in stolen and wanted goods. He supplied art collector [[Shulf'aa]] with two [[Ves Volette]] light sculptures.<ref name="sos" />

During his investigation of the sculptor's murder, former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]], along with [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]], paid a visit to Fon. Unbeknownst to the two, Fon pretended to be a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and had a [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] act as him. Pavan questioned Fon at length regarding his possible involvement in the murder and taking offense, ordered the leader of his bodyguards, [[Sele (Cathar)|Sele]], to dispatch the two. Pavan defeated Sele while Dhur caught the real Fon trying to escape. Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Pavan was able to determine that Fon wasn't lying about not being involved in the murder.<ref name="sos" />
